page.layout: One column of running text, set full width. Running head "EPISTOLA" at the top, above the text. No page number. A small mark stands in the left margin beside the line "fimo delinquenti"; it is not a readable note.

main_text.p: ego provinciam appuli, & in sacrosancti ministerii in ecclesia Christi, curriculo, licet non qua debeam, attamen qua possim, animi contentione militantem, spe, re, consilio, authoritate in dies adjuvare, complecti, & promovere, non gravate tulisti, te vindicem & assertorem appellant, salutant, patrocinium exoptant, & in authoris obsequii & gratitudinis, amplitudine tuae Chirographum, sese dicant, consecrant, & amoris sigillum testatissimum appendunt, quo confidentius, & animosius, tua fretus authoritate, ad alia quae libelli inscriptio spondet, promovear. Ista φιλοσοφω-[illegible, ~3 letters] & abstrusiora, quam par est, si quis incusabit, pro me respondeo, malo nodo, malum cuneum deberi; & amaram bilem. non nisi amaris pharmacis, dilu-endam, & hostes divinae gratiae vel in aliena castra, extra septa theologica fugientes, persequi non esse inutile & invitissimo delinquenti veniam dandam esse. Interim qua possum animi submissione, quo debeam mentis ardore, Deum patrem D. Iesu Christi invoco, ut te, & familiam tuam, omni benedictionum ge-nere

page.notes: The Greek word at the line end, after "φιλοσοφω-", is partly illegible in the scan and is marked as such. A small mark stands in the left margin beside "fimo delinquenti"; it is not transcribed. The page ends mid-sentence with "ge-" and the fragment "nere", which are copied as printed. Long s is rendered as plain s throughout.
